newsitem.title: CANADA: Caledonia cancels C$20 mln debt placement.
newsitem.headline: Caledonia cancels C$20 mln debt placement.

text.p: Caledonia Mining Corp said on Monday it decided to withdraw its proposed financing to raise C$20 million by way of a private placement financing of seven percent unsecured five-year convertible debentures.
"The continued uncertainty of the Bre-X (Minerals Ltd) situation and the poor performance of the market in general has made financing at this time very difficult," Caledonia said.

Proceeds of the offering were to be used to continue to fund further exploration and development of Caledonia's primary cobalt and copper properties in Zambia, to fund in part the capital expansion of Caledonia's Cononish gold mine and for general corporate purposes.
Caledonia said it was investigating other avenues of potential financing including joint ventures and the potential sale of certain assets.
